qrPattern.description: Original Figma motif exported as its own asset; contains no live ticket payload. It is not a screen screenshot.

frames.referenceStatus: Context screenshot available at reduced resolution; attempt to retrieve full-resolution screenshot was denied in this session. Source JSX and original assets were already retrieved before this denial.

sharedLayout: CollectionPage with optional title/home-bar colors, original Inter fonts and intrinsic-size back SVG
intentionalDemoDifferences: Ticket label and code say DEMO; organizer details do not expose a real contact number
Normal ticket links require local registration; preview links render synthetic data without creating a registration
Check-in is local and cannot prove real attendance
Calendar history says check-in sample rather than completed real participation
Normal calendar markers follow actual fixture data; preview markers at 18, 22 and 25 October match the source composition

saveImplementation.web: html2canvas-pro on a cloned ticket, after fonts/images are ready; removes the display shadow in the clone and downloads PNG without changing the live view
saveImplementation.native: captureRef tmpfile, add-only media permission, Asset.create, finally releaseCapture
saveImplementation.fallback: User may explicitly open the OS share chooser after save failure/permission denial; opening it does not claim the file was saved
saveImplementation.permission: Requested only when the save button is pressed; no gallery reads or audio/video permissions
